title: title
next_step_hint: Next: declare kinds and groups in {}
app_about: Local Itemark: manage work, facts, and terms by stable ID
cmd_merge: Merge multiple records of the same kind into one new record
global_project: Project directory; searches upward for `itemark.toml` by default
global_root: Itemark root directory, overriding project configuration
global_color: Color for human-readable output: auto (default) uses color in a terminal unless NO_COLOR is set
cmd_init: Initialize project configuration and recommended directories
cmd_add: Add a record of the given kind; Itemark assigns its stable ID
cmd_show: Show one record by stable ID
cmd_list: List records; values within one filter use OR, while different filters use AND
cmd_update: Update selected fields or sections, or move a record to another group
cmd_drop: Drop a record while preserving its ID and history
cmd_restore: Restore a dropped record, preserving its previous business state
cmd_archive: Move one or more records to the archive directory without changing IDs or status
cmd_unarchive: Move one or more records back to the active directory
cmd_check: Check required fields, sections, relations, and completion evidence
cmd_summary: Generate a current overview or handoff summary
arg_project: Project directory; searches upward for itemark.toml by default
arg_root: Itemark root directory, overriding project configuration
arg_color: Color for human-readable output: auto (default) uses color in a terminal unless NO_COLOR is set
arg_force: Overwrite existing configuration or skip the stale-content check
arg_set: Set a declared field as KEY=VALUE; repeatable
arg_body: Read the record body from a file
arg_status: Status filter: common built-in work values are todo, in_progress, blocked, and done; other values are matched verbatim. Use `itemark kind show <NAME>` to inspect values for a custom kind.
arg_archived: Show only archived records; independent of `--all`
arg_section: Set a Markdown section as NAME=CONTENT; repeatable
arg_append: Append a line to a Markdown section; repeatable
arg_save: Explicitly save a snapshot to this file; otherwise only print it
arg_reviewed: Clear the needs_review marker after reviewing a merged record
arg_ids: Stable IDs of two or more source records
arg_parent: Explicitly choose the merged record's parent
arg_no_parent: Explicitly make the merged record parentless
arg_completion_note: Provide a completion note when source values conflict
arg_completion_evidence: Provide completion evidence when source values conflict
arg_dry_run: Preview the candidate ID, conflicts, and reference rewrites without writing
group_show: Show records and kind counts for a group
kind_show: Show a kind definition and template
cmd_help: Show this help message or the help for a subcommand
diag_completion_value: completion value is recorded but is missing
diag_non_enum: is not an enum but declares values
diag_expected_color: expected one of auto, always, never, got
diag_status_missing_tip: Example: itemark list --status in_progress. Inspect custom values with `itemark kind show <NAME>`.
diag_no_config: no itemark.toml found in this directory or its parents; run `itemark init` first
diag_not_declared: is not declared in the project config
diag_root_uninitialized: Itemark root is not initialised; cannot write
diag_self_reference: must not reference the record itself
diag_completion_required: setting the completion field to its completion value requires a non-empty
diag_completion_before: ; add it (or mark the result as unverified) before recording completion
list_arg_group: Repeatable; multiple groups are matched with OR. Commas are literal value characters.
list_arg_kind: Repeatable; multiple kinds are matched with OR. Commas are literal value characters.
list_arg_status: Repeatable; state keys or raw kind values are matched with OR. Work examples: todo, in_progress, blocked, done. Use `itemark kind show <NAME>` to inspect a custom kind. Commas are literal value characters.
list_arg_merge_role: Repeatable; source, result, and none are matched with OR. source has merged_into; result has merged_from; a record can match both.
list_arg_reference_health: Repeatable; matched with OR using the highest live reference diagnostic severity. Counts only broken references and deprecated-reference warnings, not other check findings.
list_arg_needs_review: Show only merged records with needs_review=true.
